data.cultural_impact: Krushana is a Hindu name rooted in Indian history and mythology, symbolizing the love, joy, and mischievousness found in Hindu culture. This name has been passed down through generations, connecting individuals to a rich and diverse heritage. The character of Krishna, whose name this derived, has left a lasting impact on Indian art, literature, and philosophy for over 2,000 years.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Krushana offers more than just a historical connection to the Hindu faith, it is also a reminder of the spiritual importance of joy and love. Embodying the qualities of Krishna, the name is a call to bring happiness and positive energy to those around us. It serves as a reminder of the divine presence within us, encouraging us to act with love and delight in the world around us.

historical_references.reference: Krushna is a popular name for the Hindu deity Vishnu, particularly in the form of Krishna. He is believed to have appeared on earth around 5000 years ago in the Dwapara Yuga, where he played a crucial role in preserving dharma (moral order) by defeating the demon king Kamsa.

Another reference to Krushna is found in the epic Mahabharata, where he is described as the eighth avatar (incarnation) of the god Vishnu, who took birth to protect the Devas (gods) and destroy the demon king Shishupal.
